verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.lovable.dev/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured Lovable Documentation index, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The cited doc pages are also served as raw .md URLs (e.g. features/agent-mode.md), which are agent-friendly markdown. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or agent-oriented docs offering, evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content variant, and independent hands-on reports of agents consuming these docs.
